title: DCA Simulation/Backtest website
description:
A website to backtest DCA strategy "Dollar Cost Average"
Made with Python Flask

detailedDescription.content:
I researched a lot about the most robust, safe and statistically best long term investment strategies and that's when I found out about DCA "Dollar Cost Average" It basically means that you buy the same stock every month for a long period and this averages out your buy price. In the long term if you pick a stable asset like SMP500 or other indexes, or in my scenario Bitcoin then you will be almost guaranteed a profit over the long run. 

So that's why I developed this tool so I could back test the different results I would get if I picked specific stocks. For example the picture below shows that you would have earned over 1 million kr if you invested 3000kr every month in Nvidia over the last 5 years.

title: EasyRDP
description: Wrapper for windows remote desktop. Developed in C# WPF

detailedDescription.content: I had many PCs that I wanted to control over windows RDP but they did not have any sort of management system where I could store all connections. This meant that I had to make a text file with all the ipaddresses for the pcs to connect to. So instead I decided to develop this project to improve the RDP experience, to store all RDPs in one place and with just a button click I could connect to any of my PCs. I programmed it in C# and designed it with WPF (XAML).
A project where I ran 9 Mini PCs to host Ethereum crypto nodes, I did this to learn about blockchain technology and in the future I may create my own blockchain.
